weather.lead: Orlando looks sunny and dry both days, then a cold front on Monday brings cooler air and a steady north breeze to the ship and islands, so Lookout Cay may feel more like the mid 70s. No tropical storms are expected; the hurricane center gives one weak low northeast of the Bahamas a 20% chance, and it should drift out to sea by the weekend. These are 5 to 11 day forecasts, so they will shift. This table gets re-checked every morning through Nov 13.

rows.forecast: Upper 40s at dawn, near 71°F by afternoon, mostly sunny
rows.wear: Long pants and a light jacket for the airport

rows.forecast: Sunny and dry, high 78 to 81°F, low 60 to 65°F
rows.wear: Shorts or light pants, layer for evening

rows.forecast: Mostly sunny and dry, high near 80°F, low to mid 60s°F at the 7:30am start
rows.wear: Light layer at rope drop, hats and sunscreen, ponchos just in case

rows.forecast: Cooler and drier after a front, high 76 to 78°F, low near 60°F, breezy
rows.wear: Easy travel clothes, a light layer for the breeze, swimsuits in the carry-on

rows.forecast: Sun and clouds, 79 to 81°F, breezy northwest wind near 15 mph, small morning shower chance
Cooler, mid to upper 70s°F, mostly cloudy, north wind 15 to 20 mph, low rain chance

rows.forecast: Mid 70s°F and breezy, past the reach of most forecasts so far
rows.wear: Pool clothes by day, a jacket for the open decks at night

rows.forecast: Cape Canaveral mid 70s°F, too far out for detail; Raleigh near 60°F by day and low 40s at night
